info.description: A comprehensive development toolkit for CashpilotX environments with profiling, monitoring, and optimization features.
info.title: CashpilotX API

post.description:
Agent endpoint: receive an aggregated batch of ORM stats and critical events.
The batch is pushed onto a Redis stream for asynchronous processing by the ingest worker.
Supports gzip-compressed bodies (Content-Encoding: gzip). Max body size: 5 MB.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of operator audit log entries. Optionally filter by action_type.

parameters.description: Filter by action type (e.g. payment_recorded, message_marked_sent)
parameters.name: action_type

post.description: Marks an audit log entry as reverted, recording who reverted it and when.
Send a 6-digit OTP to the user's registered email. Accepts phone or email as identifier.
Authenticate with phone and PIN; returns access and refresh tokens.
Revoke the current session or all sessions. Requires Bearer token.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair.
Create a new CashPilotX account with phone number and PIN.
Verify the OTP and set a new PIN. All existing sessions are revoked on success.

get.description: Return all active sessions for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Revoke a specific session by ID for the authenticated user.

get.description: Return all channel configs for the authenticated user (config payload omitted — use GET /{channel} to decrypt).

post.description: Create or update a messaging channel config (e.g. WhatsApp, Messenger). The config JSON is encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM.

get.description: Fetch a single channel config by channel name with decrypted config payload.

delete.description: Soft-delete a channel config by channel name.

patch.description: Toggle the is_active flag on a channel config.

get.description: Return a paginated list of active customers for the authenticated user.

post.description: Create a new customer record for the authenticated user.

get.description: Full-text search across customer name and phone (max 20 results).
Fetch a single customer by ID.

delete.description: Soft-delete a customer by setting their status to inactive.

patch.description: Partially update a customer's name, phone, country, notes, or tags.

get.description: Returns a paginated timeline of all events for a specific customer (payments, state changes, messages sent, etc.).
Returns the stats strip: total recoverable, waiting for reply, open actions, reminded count, collected this month, and messages sent this month.
Returns a paginated list of invoices with optional filters.

post.description: Atomically creates a new invoice and its initial reminder, generating the external_id (INV-YYYY-NNN) via the user's atomic invoice_sequence counter.

get.description: Returns a single invoice by ID, scoped to the authenticated user.

post.description: Cancels an invoice, kills its pending reminders, and reverses the unpaid balance from the customer's total_owed.

patch.description: Validates and applies a manual collection-state transition, emitting a collection_state_changed event for the History timeline.

get.description: Returns all messages (AI drafts and manual) for an invoice, newest first.
Returns all payments recorded against a specific invoice, scoped to the authenticated user.
Returns all reminders for a specific invoice, newest first.

post.description: Schedules a new reminder for an invoice. Only one active reminder (pending/processing) is allowed per invoice at a time.
Marks an invoice as defaulted and cancelled, cancels its pending reminders, and emits an invoice_written_off event.
Creates a message written by the operator (source=human, status=approved), bypassing AI draft generation.

get.description: Opens a persistent Server-Sent Events stream scoped to the authenticated user. Emits a "draft_ready" event each time the AI Draft Worker finishes generating a message draft. The client should call GET /api/v1/invoices/{id}/messages after receiving the event to fetch the new draft.

post.description: Moves a draft message to pending status, signalling the operator has approved it for sending.

get.description: Returns just the content of an approved message — the text the operator copy-pastes into LINE/WhatsApp.

post.description: Records that the operator manually sent the message via LINE/WhatsApp. Optionally stores the external message ID for delivery tracking.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all payments for the authenticated user.

post.description: Atomically inserts a payment, recomputes invoice status, and emits a payment_received event. Returns the new payment and the updated invoice snapshot.

get.description: Returns a single payment by ID, scoped to the authenticated user.
Returns open invoices ranked by AI confidence score, with customer name and phone pre-joined.

post.description: Records that the reminder was successfully sent (status → sent). Optionally stores the external message ID for tracking.

tone.description: First reminder — all optional, defaults applied in service.

session_id.description: specific session; empty = current token only

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
